import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def exponentiation_precond (b e : UInt64) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  b.toNat ^ e.toNat ≤ (2 ^ 64 - 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def exponentiation_by_squaring_aux (res b e : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : e = 0 then res
  else if e % 2 = 1 then exponentiation_by_squaring_aux (res * b) (b * b) (e / 2)
  else exponentiation_by_squaring_aux res (b * b) (e / 2)
termination_by e
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    first
      | omega
      | exact Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) (by omega)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def exponentiation (b e : UInt64) (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) : UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  UInt64.ofNat (exponentiation_by_squaring_aux 1 b.toNat e.toNat)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def exponentiation_postcond (b e : UInt64) (result : UInt64) (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.toNat = b.toNat ^ e.toNat
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
/-- Conservation invariant : `aux res b e = res * b ^ e`. -/
theorem aux_spec :
    ∀ (n e res b : Nat), e ≤ n →
      exponentiation_by_squaring_aux res b e = res * b ^ e := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro e res b he
    have he0 : e = 0 := by omega
    subst he0
    first
      | rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux]
      | rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux.eq_def]
      | unfold exponentiation_by_squaring_aux
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro e res b he
    first
      | rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux]
      | rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux.eq_def]
      | unfold exponentiation_by_squaring_aux
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · subst h1
      simp
    · -- odd exponent
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, e = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨e / 2, by omega⟩
      subst hk
      have hk2 : (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k := by omega
      rw [hk2, ih k (res * b) (b * b) (by omega)]
      calc res * b * (b * b) ^ k = res * ((b ^ 2) ^ k * b) := by ring
        _ = res * (b ^ (2 * k) * b) := by rw [pow_mul]
        _ = res * b ^ (2 * k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
    · -- even exponent
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, e = 2 * k := ⟨e / 2, by omega⟩
      subst hk
      have hk2 : 2 * k / 2 = k := by omega
      rw [hk2, ih k res (b * b) (by omega)]
      calc res * (b * b) ^ k = res * (b ^ 2) ^ k := by ring
        _ = res * b ^ (2 * k) := by rw [pow_mul]

/-- No overflow: the conversion is exact below `2 ^ 64`. -/
theorem uint64_toNat_ofNat (n : Nat) (hn : n < 2 ^ 64) : (UInt64.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  have h : (UInt64.ofNat n).toNat = n % 2 ^ 64 := by
    first
      | rfl
      | simp [UInt64.toNat_ofNat]
      | simp [UInt64.toNat, UInt64.ofNat, UInt64.size, BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
      | simp [UInt64.size]
      | simp
  omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem exponentiation_postcond_satisfied (b e : UInt64)
    (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) :
    exponentiation_postcond b e (exponentiation b e h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hp : b.toNat ^ e.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 1 := h_precond
  have hspec : exponentiation_by_squaring_aux 1 b.toNat e.toNat = b.toNat ^ e.toNat := by
    rw [aux_spec e.toNat e.toNat 1 b.toNat le_rfl, one_mul]
  have hlt : b.toNat ^ e.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hp (by norm_num)
  unfold exponentiation_postcond exponentiation
  rw [hspec]
  exact uint64_toNat_ofNat _ hlt
  -- !benchmark @end proof
